name: Transformative Hope
lines: (3 items) Gain Minor Aegis, reducing damage taken from monsters by 5%.

(5 items) While in combat, when you heal yourself or an ally that is below 50% Health, you ignite a Spark of Hope within them for 3 seconds. If they are above 90% Health when the effect ends, you and the ally gain Major Heroism for 15 seconds. This effect can occur once every 20 seconds per target.

name: Trappings of Invigoration
lines: (5 items) When you cast an ability that costs resources while under 25% Stamina, you restore 11350 Stamina. This effect can occur once every 45 seconds.

name: Treasure Hunter
lines: (5 items) Adds 171 Weapon and Spell Damage, Gain Major Savagery at all times, increasing your Weapon and Spell Critical rating by 2629.

name: Tremorscale
lines: (2 items) When you activate a taunt ability on an enemy, you cause a duneripper to burst from the ground beneath them after 1 second, dealing 2240 Physical damage to all enemies within 4 meters and reducing their Armor by 880 for 15 seconds. This effect can occur once every 10 seconds and scales off the higher of your Physical or Spell Resistance.

name: Trial by Fire
lines: (5 items) While under the effect of an Elemental Status Effect you gain 8500 Armor.

name: Trinimac's Valor
lines: (5 items) When you cast a damage shield, you call down a fragment of Trinimac that heals you and group members for 1396 Health and damages enemies for 1396 Magic damage in a 5 meter radius after a 2 second delay. This effect can occur once every 5 seconds and scales with the higher of your Max Magicka or Stamina.

name: True-Sworn Fury
lines: (3 items) Adds 129 Weapon and Spell Damage
(5 items) Adds 708 Critical Chance and increases your Critical Damage by 4%. While in combat, this bonus doubles when you are under 75% Health and quadruples when you are under 50% Health.

name: Turning Tide
lines: (5 items) When you Block, you gain Flowing Water for 10 seconds, causing your next Bash attack to deal 2224 Magic Damage to up to 6 enemies in a 5 by 10 meter line, and apply Major Vulnerability for 10 seconds, increasing their damage taken by 10%. This effect can occur once every 15 seconds and scales off your Max Health.
